# Ridhant Speciality Chemicals LLP

> Rapidly emerging speciality chemicals company based in Kota, Rajasthan, India. Supplies metallic stearates, 12-HSA salts, PE and PP waxes, liquid stearate dispersions, antioxidants, fillers, food additives, stabilisers, antistatic additives, oxo-biodegradable additives and other speciality chemicals to manufacturers across the globe, with application and technical support.

Contact: info@ridhantchemicals.com, +91 99294 77295. Address: Plot No. 50, New Grain Mandi, DCM Road, Kota, Rajasthan 324007, India (Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/4vucG1acEwjMCmqj7). Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm IST. Technical data sheets, safety data sheets and samples on request.

## Product families

### Metallic Stearates
Zinc, calcium, magnesium, aluminium, sodium and potassium stearates, working as lubricants, release agents, acid scavengers and stabilisers.
- Zinc Stearate: Lubricant, release agent and flatting agent; improves flow and surface finish.
- Calcium Stearate: Acid scavenger and internal lubricant for PVC and polyolefins; water repellent for construction.
- Magnesium Stearate: Internal and external lubricant for plastics; improves texture, adhesion and stability in personal care.
- Aluminium Stearate: Thickener, gelling and matting agent for paints, inks and greases.
- Sodium Stearate: Functional additive and lubricant for plastics; cleansing, emulsifying and gelling agent in personal care.
- Potassium Stearate: Processing aid.

### 12-HSA Salts
Zinc, calcium, lithium and magnesium salts of 12-hydroxystearic acid (12-HSA) for grease thickening, lubrication and mould release.
- Zinc 12-Hydroxystearate: Zinc salt of 12-hydroxystearic acid (12-HSA); lubricant.
- Calcium 12-Hydroxystearate: Calcium 12-HSA salt; thickener for calcium greases and lubricant for engineering plastics.
- Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate: Lithium 12-HSA soap; the standard thickener for multipurpose and high-temperature lithium greases.
- Magnesium 12-Hydroxystearate: Magnesium 12-HSA salt; lubricant for engineering plastics.

### Liquid Dispersions
Water-based calcium and zinc stearate dispersions.
- Calcium Stearate Dispersion: Water-based dispersion.
- Zinc Stearate Dispersion: Water-based dispersion.

### PE & PP Waxes
LDPE- and HDPE-based waxes, PP wax, oxidised PE wax and PE wax emulsions.
- PE Wax (LDPE & HDPE): Processing aid.
- PP Wax: Processing aid.
- Oxidised PE Wax: Processing aid.
- PE Wax Emulsion: Processing aid.

### Antioxidants
Primary and secondary antioxidants that protect polymers and oils from heat and oxidation.
- Antioxidant 1010: Additive.
- Antioxidant 168: Additive.
- Antioxidant 225 & Blends: Additive.

### Fillers & Minerals
Talc, Calcium Hydroxide, Calcium Oxide and Calcium Carbonate
- Talc: Additive.
- Calcium Hydroxide (Hydrated Lime): Additive.
- Calcium Oxide (CaO): Additive.
- Calcium Carbonate (CaCO₃): Additive.

### Food Additives
Calcium Propionate / Sodium Propionate / GMS-SE / GMS-NSE
- Calcium Propionate: Additive.
- Sodium Propionate: Additive.
- GMS-SE / GMS-NSE: Glycerol monostearate, self- and non-self-emulsifying, for food and cosmetic emulsions.

### Stabilisers
PVC Stabilisers / UV Stabilisers
- PVC Stabilisers: Heat stabiliser systems for pipes, profiles and cables.
- UV Stabilisers: Protects polymers and coatings against sunlight degradation.

### Antistatic Additives
GMS 90/95
- Glycerol Monostearate (GMS 90/95): Distilled monoglyceride; antistatic agent.

### Oxo-Biodegradable Additives
CES / COS / MNS
- CES: Additive.
- COS: Additive.
- MNS: Additive.

### Other Speciality Chemicals
Zinc Laurate / Pentaerythritol Tetrastearate (PETS) / Nucleating Agents / Ethylene Bis-Oleamide (EBO) / Antimony Trioxide (ATO) / EBS Wax
- Zinc Laurate: Internal and external lubricant, heat stabiliser and mould release agent.
- Pentaerythritol Tetrastearate (PETS): Release agent and lubricant for engineering plastics.
- Nucleating Agents: Faster cycle times, higher clarity and stiffness in polypropylene and compounds.
- Ethylene Bis-Oleamide (EBO): Slip agent, anti-blocking agent, internal and external lubricant, mould release agent and pigment dispersant for polymer and industrial manufacturing.
- Antimony Trioxide (ATO): Flame-retardant synergist for plastics and paints.
- EBS Wax: Ethylene bis-stearamide for slip, anti-block and mould release.
Further speciality grades are sourced on request; email info@ridhantchemicals.com with the grade and application.

## Industries served

- Polyolefins: Stabilisation packages for polyolefin producers and processors, built on phenolic and phosphite antioxidants.
- Plastics: Our broadest range: metallic stearates, waxes, antioxidants, stabilisers and fillers for polyolefins, PVC, masterbatch and engineering plastics. We help processors improve melt flow, surface finish and long-term stability.
- Construction: Water repellents, PVC stabilisers, fillers and moisture scavengers for gypsum, waterproofing compounds, pipes and profiles.
- Paints: PE waxes for hot melt thermoplastic road marking paint, plus matting agents, thickeners, fillers and UV stabilisers for decorative and industrial paints.
- Hot Melt Adhesives: PE and PP waxes that control viscosity, open time and setting speed, antioxidants for heat stability in the melt pot, and calcium carbonate as a cost-effective filler for packaging, bookbinding and product-assembly hot melts.
- Paper: Calcium stearate dispersions, wax emulsions and talc for paper and board coatings, giving better runnability, less dusting and improved water resistance.
- Ink & Coatings: Wax emulsions, stearate dispersions and matting agents for slip, scuff resistance and controlled gloss in printing inks and industrial coatings.
- Personal Care: Stearates, talc and GMS for creams and powders, with smooth texture and stable emulsions.
- Lubricants: Thickeners and antioxidants for greases and industrial lubricants, including lithium 12-hydroxystearate, aluminium stearate and calcium stearate.
- Abrasives: Zinc stearate dispersions as anti-tack and release agents for bonded and coated abrasives.
- Food: Calcium and sodium propionate preservatives and GMS emulsifiers for bakery, dairy and processed foods.
